## Core Skills

- Backend: Python, FastAPI, Django, REST API, WebSocket, Celery.
- Frontend: React, TypeScript, Next.js, Vite, React Native, Telegram Mini Apps.
- Data and infrastructure: PostgreSQL, MySQL, Redis, MongoDB, Kafka, Docker, Nginx, Linux, CI/CD, monitoring.
- AI/LLM: AI integrations, RAG, AI agents, Ollama, AI translation, product workflows around LLMs.
- Growth and SEO: technical SEO, analytics, content strategy, programmatic/catalog SEO.
- Blockchain/game systems: TON, FunC, IPFS, real-time game events.
